text.en:
1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Judges' Remuneration (Amendment
of First and Fifth Schedules) Regulations 2005.

425                                      P.U. (A) 67.

(2) These Regulations are deemed to have come into operation on 1 January

New First Schedule

2. The Judges' Remuneration Act 1971, which is referred to as the "Act" in
these Regulations, is amended by substituting for the First Schedule the following
schedule:

"First SCHEDULE
[Section 2(1)]

(1)                             (2)                       (3)
Judges                           Salary                 Effective date
(pensionable)
1. Chief Justice                      RM15,972.00               1-1-2004
per month
2. President of the Court of Appeal    RM14,002.12               1-1-2004
per month

3. Chief Judge of the High Court      RM13,869.02               1-1-2004
in Malaya                          per month

4. Chief Judge of the High Court      RM13,509.65              1-1-2004
in Sabah dan Sarawak             per month

5. Judges of the Federal Court        RM13,017.18              1-1-2004
per month

6. Judges of the Court of Appeal       RM12,531.37              1-1-2004
per month

7. Judges of the High Courts in        RM12,045.55              1-1-2004".
Malaya and Sabah and Sarawak     per month

Amendment of Fifth Schedule

3. The Fifth Schedule to the Act is amended in paragraph 1 by substituting
for the figures "9,982.50" the figures "10,980.75".

Made 29 January 2005
[PM(BK) R.11880/A/054/22 Jld. 8; PN(PU*?)91/III)

By Command

Dato' Seri ABDULLAH BIN Haji AHMAD BADAWI
Prime Minister
